results.title: Combinatorics 7 Points Alice and Bob each | StudyX
results.snippet: To find the probability that Alice's roll is greater than or equal to Bob's roll, we can use the concept of symmetry and complementary probability. Total Possible Outcomes: Each die has 12 sides, so the total number of possible outcomes when both Alice and Bob roll their dice is 12×12=144.
